subject: Draft MAP doc and ops checklist for Carmel Health evaluation
messages:
From: Sarah Ho <sarah.ho@averysolutions.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: eval-team@carmelhealth.com
Date: 2026-06-22T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: MAP / evaluation template request — Carmel Health pilot

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Carmel Health is keen to move from discovery to a short evaluation (goal: confirm safety & latency at scale) and they asked if we could share a MAP-style template and an ops checklist we can use to align stakeholders.

High level: they want a 30-day technical pilot with an engineering validation week and a security review. Their procurement lead also asked for an acceptance criteria matrix. Can you share:
- a MAP template (roles, milestones, gating criteria)
- a short slide deck for the kickoff
- an ops checklist for infra/keys/networking

I attached our internal evaluation requirements (PDF) so you can see their asks. Will loop in Carmel’s evaluation channel once we have a draft.

Available for a 30–45 min sync on Wed/Thu afternoons PST.

Appreciate it —
Sarah
Avery Solutions
Attachments: Carmel_Eval_Requirements.pdf
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Ho <sarah.ho@averysolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation template request — Carmel Health pilot

Sarah — thanks, this is helpful. Attaching a working MAP template and a short kickstart slide set; I also added a one-page ops checklist focusing on the private deployment items Carmel mentioned (networking, KMS, audit logs).

Quick notes:
- Proposed pilot structure: week 0: kickoff & access; week 1: smoke tests + latency baseline; weeks 2–3: feature validation + data privacy checks; week 4: acceptance & handoff.
- Roles (as I’ve stubbed in the doc):
  - Redwood PM / executive sponsor: Michael Grant
  - Success / close lead: Marissa Cole
  - Technical lead (infra/runtime): Connor O'Brien
  - Customer engineering lead: [Carmel Eng Lead] (please fill)
- Gating criteria: safety tests (sanitization score), 99th percentile latency under target, and a regression-free quality delta on our smoke prompts.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the MAP doc and add Carmel-specific acceptance metrics (I left inline comments)
2) Pick a kickoff slot (we can do Thu 6/24 10:00–10:45 PST or Fri 6/25 13:00–13:45 PST)
3) Connor will prepare an infra readiness checklist + temporary credential flows for the pilot environment once dates are locked.

Links / attachments (stubs):
- MAP_template_v0.gdoc — https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-MAP-template
- MAP_kickstart_slides_v0.gslides — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/placeholder-kickstart-assets
- Carmel_Eval_Requirements.pdf (from Sarah)

If the times above don’t work for Carmel, send two alternatives and we’ll adjust. Marissa/Connor — tagging you for alignment on resourcing and initial pricing guardrails.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
